sections.section_title: Clinical Presentation and the Challenge of Atypical Symptoms
sections.description: This section focuses on the initial presentation of the patient, highlighting the variety of symptoms and the common diagnostic pitfalls encountered during the early stages of the case.
subtopics: Characterizing chronic occipital and vertex headaches

sections.section_title: Pathophysiology of Chiari Malformation Type I (CMI)
sections.description: This section provides the necessary anatomical and physiological background to understand how structural abnormalities in the posterior fossa lead to the symptoms described in the case.
subtopics: Anatomy of the foramen magnum and the definition of CMI

sections.description: This section details the clinicians' process of moving from vague symptoms to a unifying diagnosis, contrasting the negative results of initial investigations with the pivotal role of imaging.
subtopics: Differential diagnosis of oropharyngeal choking: GERD, Myasthenia Gravis, and pulmonary pathology

sections.section_title: Neurological Basis of Respiratory and Bulbar Dysfunction
sections.description: This section explores the specific neurological failures occurring in the patient, specifically the loss of automatic breathing and the neurogenic nature of her dysphagia.
